name: neutral_beta0_finger_separated
description: Optional neutral SMPL-X beta=0 humanoid with independent visual and collision geometry for every finger link.
model_source: SMPL-X neutral body with all ten shape coefficients set to zero; the source body model is not required at runtime.
compatibility_note: This optional asset preserves the SMPL-X link names used by the motion runtime, but its additional finger collisions change contact physics and benchmark collision measurements relative to the paper-default hand-merged asset.
